name: Kenji Tanaka
bio:
Kenji Tanaka's journey into motorsport catering began unexpectedly. After years managing a traditional ryokan in Kyoto, he noticed a gap in the market for high-quality, authentic Japanese cuisine at racing events. He envisioned a catering service that could offer both traditional Japanese fare and innovative fusion dishes to a discerning international audience.

Joining Caterham Motorsport was a pivotal moment. Kenji immediately set about overhauling the team's catering, introducing locally sourced ingredients and healthier menu options. His commitment to quality and efficiency has dramatically improved team morale and performance. He believes that a well-fed team is a winning team, and he strives to provide the best possible culinary experience for everyone involved.

Kenji's deep understanding of Japanese hospitality, combined with his passion for motorsport, makes him a unique and valuable asset to the Caterham team. His innovative approach to catering and dedication to excellence are constantly raising the bar for culinary standards within the sport.
